title: 第9章 大乾第一神医
slug: 快活小御医恭喜皇后有喜了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

林墨心中一动：“孙百草？号称大乾第一神医的那位？”

“没错！”慕容雪点了点头，秀眉微蹙。

“此人是杏林泰斗，医术通神，在民间声望极高。”

“但他性格极为古板方正，最重礼法规矩，而且他早年受过武家的恩惠，算是太后的人。”

“太后早不请，晚不请，偏偏在今天早朝后，请他进宫，其意不言自明。”

慕容雪担忧道：“她这么做，很可能是冲着你来的！”

林墨眉头微皱。

他抱着温香软玉的美艳皇后，享受着这羡煞无数男人的欢愉。

差点忘了，自己还身处在怎样一个凶险的漩涡之中。

太后的反击，比他想象的还要快。

看来，这皇宫里的日子，注定不会平静。

第二天一早，天还蒙蒙亮，慈宁宫的懿旨就传遍了，整个太医院。

武太后……病了。

懿旨下令，着太医院正六品院丞林墨，即刻入宫会诊。

同时，宫外请来的神医孙百草，也已在偏殿候着了。

消息一出，整个后宫前朝，无数双眼睛都盯向了慈宁宫。

林墨换上一身崭新的六品官服，对着铜镜整理了一下衣冠，脸上看不出丝毫紧张。

慕容雪满脸担忧地替他理了理衣领：“你有把握吗？那孙百草成名数十年，绝非浪得虚名。”

林墨转过身，握住她的冰凉小手，微微一笑：“兵来将挡，水来土掩。”

“放心，我要是处理不了这点小事，以后还怎么伺候娘娘您啊！”

慕容雪俏脸微红，轻啐了一口。

当林墨在皇帝刘烈的掩护下，悄悄离开凤仪宫，绕道赶到慈宁宫时，殿内已经站满了人。

左侧，是以武太后弟弟武成业为首的几位武将，一个个盔明甲亮，煞气腾腾。

右侧，则是几位须发皆白的老臣，都是太后党羽中的核心文官。

这些人名为探病，实为观战，是来给孙百草撑腰，顺便看林墨笑话的。

大殿中央，站着一位仙风道骨，须发皆白的老者。

对方身穿一袭朴素的青布长袍，背着一个半旧的药箱，正是“药王”孙百草。

他神情倨傲，闭目养神，连林墨走进来，也只是掀了掀眼皮，便不再理会。

“林院丞，你总算来了！”武太后身边的老太监，阴阳怪气道。

“太后娘娘和孙神医，可等候多时了。”

林墨拱了拱手，淡然开口：“为太后娘娘分忧，是臣的本分。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Lin Mo's heart moved: "Sun Baicao? The one who is known as the number one miracle doctor in Daqian?"

"That's right!" Murong Xue nodded and frowned slightly.

"This man is the master of Xinglin. He has great medical skills and has a very high reputation among the people."

"But his character is extremely upright and upright, and he attaches great importance to etiquette and rules. Moreover, he received favor from the Wu family in his early years, and he can be regarded as a member of the Queen Mother."

"The Queen Mother did not invite him earlier or later, but she invited him into the palace after the morning session today. Her intention is self-evident."

Murong Xue said worriedly: "She is probably doing this for you!"

Lin Mo frowned slightly.

He held the beautiful queen with warm and fragrant nephrite in his arms, enjoying the pleasure that envied countless men.

I almost forgot what kind of dangerous whirlpool I was still in.

The Queen Mother's counterattack was faster than he imagined.

It seems that the days in this palace are destined to be uneventful.

Early the next morning, when it was still dark, the news of Cining Palace spread throughout the Imperial Hospital.

Empress Dowager Wu...is ill.

Yi Zhi ordered that Lin Mo, the Prime Minister of the Sixth Grade Hospital of Taiyuan Hospital, immediately enter the palace for consultation.

At the same time, Sun Baicao, the miracle doctor invited from outside the palace, was already waiting in the side hall.

As soon as the news came out, the entire harem moved forward, and countless pairs of eyes were fixed on Cining Palace.

Lin Mo put on a brand new sixth-grade official uniform and straightened his clothes in front of the bronze mirror. There was no trace of nervousness on his face.

Murong Xue straightened his collar with a worried look on her face: "Are you sure? Sun Baicao has been famous for decades. He is definitely not in vain."

Lin Mo turned around, held her cold little hand, and smiled slightly: "The soldiers will block it, and the water will cover it."

"Don't worry, if I can't handle this little thing, how can I serve you in the future?"

Murong Xue's pretty face turned slightly red and she spat lightly.

When Lin Mo quietly left Fengyi Palace under the cover of Emperor Liu Lie and took a detour to Cining Palace, the palace was already full of people.

On the left side, there are several military generals headed by Empress Dowager Wu's younger brother Wu Chengye, all with bright helmets and fierce aura.

On the right side, there are several veterans with white beards and hair, all of whom are core civil servants among the Queen Mother's followers.

These people were called visiting patients, but they were actually watching the battle. They came to support Sun Baicao and watch Lin Mo's jokes.

In the center of the hall, stood an old man with an immortal spirit and white beard and hair.

The other party was wearing a simple green cloth robe and carrying a half-used medicine box. It was the "King of Medicine" Sun Baicao.

He looked arrogant and closed his eyes to rest. Even when Lin Mo walked in, he just raised his eyelids and ignored him.

"Lin Yuancheng, you are finally here!" the old eunuch next to Empress Dowager Wu said with a strange air.

"The Queen Mother and Divine Doctor Sun have been waiting for a long time."

Lin Mo cupped his hands and said calmly: "It is my duty to share the Queen Mother's worries."
